description: Niraparib is recommended as an option for treating relapsed, platinum-sensitive high-grade serous epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer that has responded to the most recent course of platinum-based chemotherapy in adults, only if: they have a BRCA mutation and have had 2 courses of platinum-based chemotherapy, or they do not have a BRCA mutation and have had 2 or more courses of platinum-based chemotherapy, and the company provides it according to the commercial arrangement.

extensions.name: statement description
extensions.value: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended niraparib, within its marketing authorisation, for treating relapsed, platinum-sensitive high-grade serous epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer that has responded to the most recent course of platinum-based chemotherapy in adults either with a BRCA mutation, after 2 courses of platinum-based chemotherapy, or without a BRCA mutation, after 2 or more courses of platinum-based chemotherapy. Niraparib is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial arrangement available to the NHS.
